current.research_stage: Session 5: the competition inputs were restored in this checkout (bash scripts/download_competition_data.sh -> 11/11 pinned owner-mirror files SHA-256 verified) and the pipeline was run end to end (prepare_data: 5,167,373 footprint px, 60,988 label px, 19 bands; build_features: 64 static columns; build_addons: 5 add-ons). Building an A4_h41_union artifact with the existing single-fit recipe then produced a file byte-identical to the published repo-c0 candidate (sha256 3537e9fc47a46503..., content id a4d439b07426), which exposed a real defect: scripts/build_repo_candidate.py builds catalogue family E from the same full catalogue its positives come from, so E_dist is exactly 0.0 on all 60,988 positives and >= 1.098612 on all sampled negatives - train AUC 1.0, tree-1 root split E_dist at 0.0, only 2 of 81 columns ever used, 0 splits on the H41 columns (IR-29-ARTIFACT-LEAK, knowledge/27). The screens in evidence/ are unaffected because Cell builds E from draw.visible. Fix: scripts/build_crossfit_candidate.py trains per (fold, draw) with features from draw.visible and positives = draw.hidden_train, applies the models to the full footprint, averages over 4 folds x draws 30/31, and runs the unchanged frozen emission. It now uses 78-86 columns per cell with 1,207 H41 splits, and emits two distinct masks - C0 33,766 dots (ca879db0089a) and A4_h41_union 33,739 dots (9edb34b99e3a) - with catalogue-hugging down from 0.6595 to ~0.15, and it aborts if the H41 block is inert or the arms are indistinguishable. Both are published with a zero-outside variant because the owner's reported 'Predicted values must be in range [0, 1]' rejection is reproduced exactly by the NaN-outside file under a strict whole-array check. Session 4 records stand unchanged.
